title: Sfregazzi
content: The termsfregazziis an Italian term used in oil painting to refer to shadows applied as a glaze with the fingers over flesh tones. It is accomplished by gently rubbing shadows over lighter areas. Pictured: Rembrandt self-portrait.--From:Oxford ReferenceMore at Circolo d'Arti / La tecnica di pittura ad olio di Rembrandt
